gen-vast-shadow-gf-geist: Vast Shadow cuts every stroke to a single width and stands on a tall, spacious frame that looks pulled from an old shopfront. Geist is the quiet one, a level sans whose words sit as solid blocks while the heading does the shouting.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-geist-mono: Vast Shadow looks vintage and loud, every stroke cut to one width with generous gaps around each letter. Geist Mono answers with fixed-width, code-style lowercase that rises high, so the heading grabs the eye and the body keeps things orderly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-georama: Vast Shadow draws every stroke at a single width, with a tall mean line and lots of space around each letter. Georama is a friendly plain sans with barely rising capitals.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-gidole: Open terminals and a high-set midline give this body a tidy, neon-tube consistency that never fusses. Gidole handles that quiet reading job in a plain sans, while Vast Shadow is the vintage showpiece with its tall mean line and spacious letters.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with a big x-height and a widely parted s, all built from one width of stroke. Golos Text feels contemporary and approachable next to Vast Shadow, whose vintage, eye-catching letters carry the real swagger.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachable and modern, with a wide gap where the c ends and small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Hedvig Letters Sans lets Vast Shadow's outlined, vintage letters stay the showpiece, and the two feel like a loud poster hung above friendly small print.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-heebo: Heebo reads as a tall central band of text, with curves that stop short instead of closing in. Heebo is the steady, professional workhorse while Vast Shadow supplies vintage attention, tracing each letter with joins as slim as a pipe cleaner.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-guntur: Stamped metal, basically. Hind Guntur has tall lowercase, wide gaps between curve ends and stems, and no thick-thin shift, so it feels modern and plain beside the vintage, show-off letters of Vast Shadow.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-madurai: Approachable is the first word for this pair's body text, with s curves that open wide at both ends. Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands like capitals, giving Vast Shadow's vintage, tall-framed letters a friendly neighbor.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru presses its lowercase close to ascender height. Its a keeps its mouth ajar and its strokes skip calligraphic thinning, so this plain sans does the steady work while Vast Shadow handles the vintage, eye-catching showmanship.
